candidate_sub77_dual_cb_high_margin_unpr.description: Top 20 unprobed high-margin disagreements between Dual CatBoost R150 and S48
candidate_sub77_dual_cb_high_margin_unpr.purpose: Test if pure model confidence over S48 yields positive score on virgin test items.
candidate_sub77_dual_cb_high_margin_unpr.decision_positive: Licenses promoting high-confidence pure-model predictions into the adaptive 5th slot.
candidate_sub77_dual_cb_high_margin_unpr.decision_negative: Confirms S48 pseudo-labels are superior to raw model margin on boundary items.

candidate_sub78_model_consensus_unprobed.description: Top 25 unprobed consensus flips where Dual CatBoost and Strong Ensemble agree against S48
candidate_sub78_model_consensus_unprobed.purpose: Test cross-architecture consensus (leaf-wise LightGBM + oblivious CatBoost) vs S48.
candidate_sub78_model_consensus_unprobed.decision_positive: Validates ensemble consensus as a trusted signal for flipping S48.
candidate_sub78_model_consensus_unprobed.decision_negative: Proves model agreement on certain items reflects shared training bias rather than ground truth.

candidate_sub79_new_sellers_clean_text.description: 20 unprobed new-seller items with explicit lexical/warranty cues disagreeing with S48
candidate_sub79_new_sellers_clean_text.purpose: Test pure text condition cues on new sellers where seller-ID cannot leak or mislead.
candidate_sub79_new_sellers_clean_text.decision_positive: Unlocks high-precision lexical overrides for all unprobed new-seller items.
candidate_sub79_new_sellers_clean_text.decision_negative: Proves keyword heuristics on MercadoLibre text have high false-positive rates due to seller boilerplate.

candidate_sub80_seen_sellers_conservativ.description: 15 unprobed seen-seller items with clean seller history, strictly disjoint from refuted 72-74 sellers
candidate_sub80_seen_sellers_conservativ.purpose: Test conservative seen-seller flipping without the full-seller flipping contagion that harmed 72-74.
candidate_sub80_seen_sellers_conservativ.decision_positive: Confirms seen-seller model signals can be selectively applied when refuted seller clusters are isolated.
candidate_sub80_seen_sellers_conservativ.decision_negative: Establishes that seen sellers in S48 are already saturated and should not be modified further.
